NICLIS Tile Insert Drains are designed for both functionality and pleasing aesthetics, and integrate seamlessly in any tiled bathroom floor, offering an efficient form of drainage without being overly obtrusive in appearance.

Codes: KFG-R902, KFG-R902B, KFG-R902G, KFG-R902N
new:
The NICLIS Round Tile Insert Floor Drain 115 x 115 x 75 mm hides the floor waste under a piece of your own tile, leaving only a thin slot of metal showing. It is the round-profile version of the NICLIS 115 mm tile insert, 75 mm deep, in four finishes to match the tapware.

Use it for

  • Shower floors and bathroom floors tiled in large or patterned tiles
  • Bathrooms fitted out in round-profile tapware and accessories

Specifications

  • Size: 115 mm x 115 mm
  • Depth: 75 mm
  • Finishes: Chrome (KFG-R902), Matt Black (KFG-R902B), Brushed Gold (KFG-R902G), Satin Nickel (KFG-R902N)

Good to know

  • Confirm the depth suits the screed and the waste set-out with your plumber or tiler before the screed goes down.
  • Cut the tile insert from an offcut of the floor tile so the colour matches.
  • Lift the insert to clear hair and grit. Clean coloured finishes with a soft cloth and mild detergent.
  • For a square profile, and 45 mm or 90 mm depths, see the NICLIS Square Tile Insert Floor Drain 115 x 115 mm.

title: NICLIS Waterproofing Bandage
old:
NICLIS waterproofing bandage (reinforcing tape) bedded into liquid membrane over wall-floor junctions, corners and sheet joints in showers and wet areas. Available 100mm or 200mm wide.

Codes: WPB100, WPB200, WPB200-50
new:
NICLIS Waterproofing Bandage is a reinforcing tape that is bedded into liquid waterproofing membrane over the joints most likely to crack: wall to floor junctions, internal corners and sheet joins in showers and wet areas. It bridges movement in the substrate so the membrane stays sealed where it is thinnest.

Use it for

  • Wall to floor and wall to wall junctions in showers, bathrooms and laundries
  • Joins between sheet linings and around hobs and set-downs
  • Balconies and other wet areas before tiling

Specifications

  • 100 mm x 100 m roll (WPB100)
  • 200 mm x 100 m roll (WPB200)
  • 200 mm x 50 m roll (WPB200-50)

Good to know

  • Bed the bandage into the first wet coat of membrane, centred on the joint, and cover it fully with the second coat.
  • Use the 200 mm width where the junction is uneven or the membrane maker calls for wider coverage.
  • Check your membrane's data sheet for compatibility with fabric reinforcement.
  • Store the roll dry and clean. Dust on the tape stops the membrane bonding.
notes: No NICLIS bandage listing found online. Written from title, options, existing description and general waterproofing practice.

  • Rolling liquid waterproofing membrane over floors and walls
  • Applying primer before membrane or adhesive
  • Sealing porous tiles and grout

Specifications

  • Model: PAN-PRF230

title: Panther Tile Levelling System Base Clips
old:
Panther tile levelling system base clips. Used with the Panther wedges and pliers to pull adjoining tiles flush and stop lippage on large format tiles. Choose your joint width and tile thickness range.

Codes: PAN-LSBC1500, PAN-LSBC500, PAN-LSBC2500, PAN-LSBCS3250, PAN-LSBC3500, PAN-LSBCL250, PAN-LSBCS1250
new:
Panther Tile Levelling System Base Clips slide under the edges of adjoining tiles while the adhesive is wet. A Panther wedge pushed through the clip pulls the two tiles flush and holds them level while it cures. Pick the clip by joint width and tile thickness.

Use it for

  • Large format floor and wall tiles where lippage shows
  • Thick stone and paver tiles, using the Stone clips

Specifications

  • 1 mm joint, 3 to 12 mm tiles, bag of 500 (PAN-LSBC1500)
  • 1.5 mm joint, 3 to 12 mm tiles, bag of 500 (PAN-LSBC500)
  • 2 mm joint, 3 to 12 mm tiles, bag of 500 (PAN-LSBC2500)
  • 3 mm joint, 3 to 12 mm tiles, bag of 500 (PAN-LSBC3500)
  • 1.5 mm joint, Large, 11 to 20 mm tiles, bag of 250 (PAN-LSBCL250)
  • 1 mm joint, Stone, 23 to 32 mm tiles, bag of 250 (PAN-LSBCS1250)
  • 3 mm joint, Stone, 23 to 32 mm tiles, bag of 250 (PAN-LSBCS3250)

Good to know

  • Use with Panther Levelling System Wedges (PAN-LSW250, PAN-LSW500) and the Panther adjustable traction pliers (PAN-LSATPF).
  • Clips are single use. Once the adhesive has cured, kick the clip along the joint line to snap it off below the tile. The wedges are reusable.

title: Atika Replacement Agitation Parts - suit Compact 100
old:
Fits: Atika Compact 100 pan mixer

Genuine Atika replacement agitation arms, blades and the complete agitation head for the Atika Compact 100 pan mixer. Choose the part you need from the list.

Codes: AT-C100-AAI, AT-C100-AAO, AT-C100-AAS, AT-C100-ABI, AT-C100-ABO, AT-C100-ABS, AT-C100-AH
new:
Genuine Atika replacement agitation parts for the Atika Compact 100 pan mixer, the 100 litre screed mixer. The agitation head has three spring-loaded arms with replaceable blades, so when a blade wears or an arm bends you replace that part rather than the whole head and keep the mixer turning out an even mix.

Use it for

  • Restoring a worn Atika Compact 100 to a full, clean mix
  • Keeping a spare blade set on hand for a mixer in daily use

Options

  • Agitation Arm, Inside Bottom (AT-C100-AAI)
  • Agitation Arm, Outside Bottom (AT-C100-AAO)
  • Agitation Arm, Side (AT-C100-AAS)
  • Agitation Blade, Inside Bottom (AT-C100-ABI)
  • Agitation Blade, Outside Bottom (AT-C100-ABO)
  • Agitation Blade, Side (AT-C100-ABS)
  • Agitation Head, complete (AT-C100-AH)

Fits

  • Atika Compact 100 pan mixer (AT-COMPACT100) only

Good to know

  • Each part is sold singly. Choose the arm or blade by its position on the head.
  • Parts for the Compact 140 are a different size and are listed separately.
  • The agitation head lifts out of the pan for washing, so check all three blades for wear each time you clean it.
  • Isolate the mixer from power before fitting parts.
notes: Mixer facts verified on battrims.com; the individual parts are not listed online, so part names come from the product options.

title: MELA Toilet Flush Button
old:
Toilet Flush Button – Simple, Stylish, and Reliable. The MELA Flush Button is designed to sit neatly on top of the toilet cistern. The clean, modern design fits into any bathroom style. It operates smoothly with every press. The flush delivers strong, reliable performance for daily use. Its compact form keeps the toilet area tidy and prevents clutter. The flush button is easy to install. It works with a wide range of toilet suites. No special tools or complicated steps are required. This makes it a practical choice for both new installations and bathroom upgrades. Built with durable materials, the button is designed to last.

  • Dimensions: 57(W) x 42(H)mm
  • Finishes: Chrome, Matt Black, Matt White, Brushed Nickel, Brushed Brass, Gun Metal
new:
The MELA Toilet Flush Button is a replacement press button for a top-flush toilet cistern, 57 mm wide by 42 mm high, in six finishes. It is the simplest way to lose the standard chrome button and match the toilet to matt black, brushed nickel, brushed brass or gun metal tapware.

Use it for

  • Matching the cistern button to coloured tapware and accessories
  • Replacing a worn, scratched or discoloured button on an existing cistern

Specifications

  • Dimensions: 57 mm (W) x 42 mm (H)
  • Mounting: top of cistern
  • Finishes: Chrome (Flush Button.CH), Matt Black (Flush Button.BK), Matt White (Flush Button.MW), Brushed Nickel (Flush Button.BN), Brushed Brass (Flush Button.BB), Gun Metal (Flush Button.GM)

Good to know

  • Measure your cistern's button cut-out against 57 x 42 mm before ordering. It is listed as fitting a wide range of toilet suites, but cistern cut-outs vary.
  • Fits by hand with no special tools.
  • For a concealed cistern see the MELA In Wall Toilet Button Round.
  • Clean with a soft cloth and mild detergent. Abrasive cleaners mark coloured finishes.
